transcript.en: Thanks for coming everyone.
transcript.zh: 谢谢大家前来。

transcript.en: OK, so this meeting is for new staff and staff who haven't been involved with our volunteering projects yet.
transcript.zh: 这次会议是针对新员工和还未参加过我们志愿者项目的员工。

transcript.en: So basically, the idea is that we allow staff to give up some of their work time to help on various charity projects to benefit the local community.
transcript.zh: 我们基本的想法就是，员工可以利用一些工作时间来参与各种慈善项目，造福当地社区。

transcript.en: We've been doing this for the last five years and it's been very successful.
transcript.zh: 过去五年来我们一直在这样做，而且非常成功。

transcript.en: Participating doesn't necessarily involve a huge time commitment.
transcript.zh: 参与这些项目并不是意味着要占用很多时间。

transcript.en: The company will pay for eight hours of your time.
transcript.zh: 如果你参与这些项目，公司将为你支付八小时的时薪。

transcript.en: That can be used over one or two days all at once, or spread over several months throughout the year.
transcript.zh: 你可以一两天做完，也可以在一年中做完。

transcript.en: There are some staff who enjoy volunteering so much they also give up their own free time for a couple of hours every week.
transcript.zh: 有一些员工非常喜欢志愿者工作，他们每周都会从自己的空闲时间中抽出几个小时。

transcript.en: It's completely up to you.
transcript.zh: 这完全取决于你本人。

transcript.en: Obviously, many people will have family commitments and aren't as available as other members of staff.
transcript.zh: 有些人因为有家庭要照顾的原因，对志愿者工作可能没有那么积极。

transcript.en: Feedback from staff has been overwhelmingly positive.
transcript.zh: 但是绝大多数员工还是很踊跃的。

transcript.en: Because they felt they were doing something really useful,
transcript.zh: 因为他们觉得自己在做一些非常有用的事情，

transcript.en: nearly everyone agreed that volunteering made them feel more motivated at work,
transcript.zh: 几乎每个人都认为志愿者工作会让他们在工作中更有动力，

transcript.en: they also liked building relationships with the people in the local community and felt valued by them.
transcript.zh: 他们也喜欢与当地社区的人建立联系，并感到受到他们的重视。

transcript.en: One or two people also said it was a good thing to have on their CVs.
transcript.zh: 也有一两个人说志愿者工作可以给他们的简历加分。

transcript.en: One particularly successful project last year was the Get Working Project.
transcript.zh: 去年一个非常成功的项目是“Get Working Project”。

transcript.en: This was aimed at helping unemployed people in the area get back to work.
transcript.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助该地区的失业人员重新就业。

transcript.en: Our staff were able to help them improve their telephone skills,
transcript.zh: 我们的员工能帮助失业人员提高他们的电话技能，

transcript.en: such as writing down messages and speaking with confidence to potential customers, which they had found quite difficult.
transcript.zh: 例如记录信息，以及自信地与潜在客户交谈，这几点对他们来说都是比较困难的。

transcript.en: This is something many employers look for in job applicants - and something we all do without even thinking about, every day at work.
transcript.zh: 这也是许多雇主对求职者的要求，也是我们每天在工作中不会去思考但会去做的事情。

transcript.en: We've got an exciting new project starting this year.
transcript.zh: 我们今年开始了一个令人兴奋的新项目。

transcript.en: Up until now, we've mainly focused on projects to do with education and training.
transcript.zh: 到目前为止，我们主要关注的是与教育和培训有关的项目。

transcript.en: And we'll continue with our reading project in schools and our work with local charities.
transcript.zh: 我们将继续我们的校园阅读项目，并继续与当地慈善机构合作。

transcript.en: But we've also agreed to help out on a conservation project in Redfern Park.
transcript.zh: 但我们也同意帮助雷德芬公园（Redfern Park）的保护项目。

transcript.en: So if any of you fancy being outside and getting your hands dirty, this is the project for you.
transcript.zh: 所以，如果大家有人喜欢户外工作，那么这个项目一定很适合你。

transcript.en: I also want to mention the annual Digital Inclusion Day, which is coming up next month.
transcript.zh: 我还想提一下下个月的年度Digital Inclusion Day。

transcript.en: The aim of this is to help older people keep up with technology.
transcript.zh: 这个活动的目的是帮助老年人跟上技术发展。

transcript.en: And this year, instead of hosting the event in our own training facility, we're using the ICT suite at Hill College, as it can hold far more people.
transcript.zh: 今年的活动不是在我们自己的培训机构举办的，而是使用希尔学院的ICT厅，可以容纳更多的人。

transcript.en: We've invited over 60 people from the Silver Age Community Centre to take part, so we'll need a lot of volunteers to help with this event.
transcript.zh: 我们邀请了Silver Age Community Centre的60多位老人参与，因此我们需要很多志愿者来帮助完成此次活动。

transcript.en: If you're interested in taking part, please go to the volunteering section of our website and complete the relevant form.
transcript.zh: 如果你有兴趣参与，请登录我们网站的志愿者工作板块，并填写相关表格。

transcript.en: We won't be providing any training for this but you'll be paired with an experienced volunteer if you've never done it before.
transcript.zh: 我们不会为此提供任何培训，如果你以前从来没有过志愿者工作经验，我们会让你与一名经验丰富的志愿者配对。

transcript.en: By the way, don't forget to tell your manager about any volunteering activities you decide to do.
transcript.zh: 顺便说一下，记得和上级经理报备一下你决定参加的志愿者工作。

transcript.en: The participants on the Digital Inclusion Day really benefited.
transcript.zh: Digital Inclusion Day的参与者也可以获得很多收获。

transcript.en: The majority were in their seventies, though some were younger and a few were even in their nineties!
transcript.zh: 他们中的大多人是七十多岁，有些更小，有些则九十多岁。

transcript.en: Quite a few owned both a computer and a mobile phone, but these tended to be outdated models.
transcript.zh: 不少人有电脑和手机，但都是过时的产品。

transcript.en: They generally knew how to do simple things, like send texts, but weren't aware of recent developments in mobile phone technology.
transcript.zh: 他们通常知道如何做简单的的事情，比如发送短信，但不知道手机技术的最新发展。

transcript.en: A few were keen to learn but most were quite dismissive at first - they couldn't see the point of updating their skills. But that soon changed.
transcript.zh: 少数人热衷学习，大多数人一开始都很不屑 - 他们不知道更新技能的意义。但这种观念很快就改变了。

transcript.en: The feedback was very positive.
transcript.zh: 参与者的反馈非常积极。

transcript.en: The really encouraging thing was that participants all said they felt much more confident about using social media to keep in touch with their grandchildren,
transcript.zh: 真正鼓舞人心的是，所有参与者都表示，他们对使用社交媒体与孙辈保持联系更有信心，

transcript.en: who prefer this form of communication to phoning or sending emails.
transcript.zh: 因为孙辈更喜欢这种沟通方式，而不是打电话或发送电子邮件。

transcript.en: A lot of them also said playing online games would help them make new friends and keep their brains active.
transcript.zh: 他们中的很多人也表示，玩网络游戏可以帮助他们认识新朋友，并让大脑保持活跃。

transcript.en: They weren't that impressed with being able to order their groceries online, as they liked going out to the shops,
transcript.zh: 网购没有给他们留下什么深刻印象，因为他们喜欢去商店购物，

transcript.en: but some said it would come in handy if they were ill or the weather was really bad.
transcript.zh: 但是有些人说，如果生病或者天气非常糟糕，网购就非常有用。

transcript.en: One thing they asked about was using tablets for things like reading newspapers -
transcript.zh: 他们希望使用平板电脑来做的一件事情就是看报纸 -

transcript.en: some people had been given tablets as presents but had never used them,
transcript.zh: 有些人收到了平板电脑作为礼物，但是从来没有打开来用过，

transcript.en: so that's something we'll make sure we include this time ...
transcript.zh: 所以在这个问题上这次我们必须……
